about.heading: A small family shop, sharing what we stand for.
paragraphs: Shield of Faith Design is a small family-run shop. We make original artwork about faith, family, and freedom — the things we want on our own shirts, mugs, and walls.
We draw our own designs. We do not copy official badges, patches, seals, or agency logos.
You can check out on this site. The same designs are also on Etsy. The piece is printed on demand and shipped by our print partner.

faq.question: How are items printed and shipped?
faq.answer: Items are printed on demand and shipped by our print partner. They are made after you order, not pulled from a shelf of finished goods. Production usually takes a few business days, and then the print partner ships the package.

faq.question: How do orders and returns work?
faq.answer: You can check out on this site. The same designs are also on Etsy. If something arrives damaged or misprinted, message the shop on Etsy and we will make it right. Because each piece is made to order, we cannot accept a return for a size change or a change of mind.

faq.question: Can you print an official badge, patch, or seal?
faq.answer: No. The artwork is original. We do not reproduce official badges, patches, seals, or agency logos. Listings that offer personalization can take a name, a verse, or family wording.
